title: UneceSensor
description:
An object which can detect and measure physical properties and which can record, indicate and transmit such
measurements.

actualReportedMeasurement.description: An actual calibrated measurement reported for this monitoring sensor.

definedControlSettingParameter.description: A control setting parameter defined for this monitoring sensor.

definedOperationalParameter.description: An operational parameter defined for this monitoring sensor.

grantedCertificate.description: A product certificate granted for this monitoring sensor.

identifier.description: An identifier of this monitoring sensor.

manufacturerParty.description: The manufacturer party for this monitoring sensor.

ownerParty.description: The owner party of this monitoring sensor.

positionCode.description: The code specifying a position of this monitoring sensor.

precisionMeasurement.description: A calibrated measurement of precision for this monitoring sensor.

remainingBatteryChargePercent.description: The percentage of the remaining battery charge of this monitoring sensor.

scheduledReportedMeasurement.description: A scheduled calibrated measurement reported for this monitoring sensor.

typeCode.description: The code specifying a type of monitoring sensor.

valueMeasure.description: The measure of the value for this monitoring sensor.
